name: frad-dotclaude

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Conventional Git automation, advanced repository management, and GitFlow workflow automation for feature, hotfix, and release branches with post-finish cleanup

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub project operations with quality gates

plugins.name: swiftui
plugins.description: SwiftUI code review with modern API best practices

plugins.name: office
plugins.description: Office productivity skills for patent applications, PRD generation, image and video generation, Remotion programmatic video authoring, and AI writing trope detection

plugins.name: lark
plugins.description: Feishu/Lark CLI skills, mirrored from larksuite/cli — docs, sheets, IM, calendar, approval, drive, wiki, contacts, and more

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing skills for AI agents, mirrored from coreyhaines31/marketingskills — CRO, copywriting, SEO, paid ads, ad creative, analytics, and growth

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: HyperFrames HTML-based video authoring skills, mirrored from heygen-com/hyperframes — keyframes, animation, captions, motion graphics, and remotion-to-hyperframes conversion

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Agent and skills for code simplification and refactoring to improve code quality while preserving functionality

plugins.name: mattpocock
plugins.description: BDD-first engineering skills forked from mattpocock/skills v1.2.3

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Advanced development workflow orchestration with BDD support and self-improving skills

plugins.name: plugin-optimizer
plugins.description: Validates and optimizes Claude Code plugins against official best practices and file patterns

plugins.name: acpx
plugins.description: Knowledge base for acpx - a headless ACP CLI for agent-to-agent communication

plugins.name: code-context
plugins.description: Retrieve code context for any repo, library, or natural-language query via DeepWiki, Context7, Exa, git clone, and web search+fetch

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: General-purpose utility skills for documentation, writing, and project maintenance

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous research loop inspired by karpathy/autoresearch — give it a plain-language goal; it infers a recommended contract, then grills each decision with you (goal measurability, artifact, evaluator, bounds) before iterating: cheap sequential rounds that escalate to a parallel GAN tournament when they plateau

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Delegate tasks and deep research to Google Gemini Managed Agents (Antigravity) running in a remote sandbox, then read the results back

plugins.name: storm
plugins.description: Wikipedia-style long-form article generation via multi-perspective question asking and retrieval — a Claude-native port of Stanford STORM's two-stage research-to-article pipeline

plugins.name: hardware
plugins.description: Hardware and EDA toolkit. Drives the KiCad CLI for schematic/PCB export and checks, and OpenSCAD for parametric 3D/2D part design and STL/DXF/PNG output.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Consolidates a Claude Code project's memory — private harness and repo-local — as one unlayered store

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Bridges to pi (dev/pi), a minimal terminal coding harness. Delegates coding tasks to the pi CLI for execution with full file and git context.

plugins.name: interfaces
plugins.description: Agent skills for building great product interfaces, from typography and color to accessibility and UX writing
